reviews.text: This game is fantastic! It's like Luck Be A Landlord but *way* more fun! There are so many coins and relics and combos you can build. I played this as the demo and loved it even then! The devs are always happy to help and are really nice! I have spent nearly 30 hours playing the demo alone because it's addicting :) Seriously, give this game a try, it's less than $10 for literal hours of entertainment. As a note, the reason I got the product for free is because I was doing game videos. :)

https://youtu.be/cocHREqhSXQ Honestly such an addicting and fun roguelike. If you are a fan of Dice A Million or Raccoin (it's like if those two had a baby) then you will have a blast with this. There are an insane amount of coins and combos that work together and I haven't even scratched the surface since I have only played with two of the coin packs so far. If you want to see some game play you should just play the demo or you can check out my video above.
从DEMO就开始玩了好久，主要偏向于休闲。很适合我晚上睡不着，不想写汇报游玩。 《硬币酒馆》是一款画风轻松治愈的休闲类游戏，没有硬核烧脑的操作门槛，节奏舒缓，摸鱼，整体偏向轻松解压，而非高强度竞技。酒馆人物造型呆萌可爱。一款舒服解压的轻量化休闲硬币小游戏，用来打发闲暇时光恰到好处，佛系游玩体验极佳。
Very fun game - another banger you flip coins and the coins have powers - super easy premise but fun implementation.
fun game to mess around with, can be challenging at times but I probably just need to strategize better, worth the money, I like the art style

Roguelite coin flipper in the vein of Luck be a Landlord. Picture-side coins trigger effects, relics build synergies, gold bomb turned a 10,000 target into 25,000. Three hours disappeared. Play.
Every coin looks harmless until it finds the right partner. What begins as simple coin tosses slowly transforms into a machine of ridiculous combos and impossible luck. Verdict: Worth the toss.
Coin Tavern is super addictive roguelike coin deck builder. Collect various coins and effects, and play them right to multiply to pay your debt. Really enjoyable, will eat your time completely.
